description: Create runbook documentation for dynamic workers operations. Create docs/runbook-dynamic-workers.md covering: worker not starting troubleshooting, worker crash loop debugging, high latency diagnosis, config not reloading fixes, circuit breaker recovery, scale-to-zero issues. Include diagnostic commands, metrics to check, and resolution steps.
steps: Create docs/runbook-dynamic-workers.md with structured runbook format
Add section '## Overview' explaining the dynamic workers architecture briefly
Add section '## Quick Reference' with key metrics, endpoints, and commands

Add section '## Worker Not Starting' with: symptoms (pod stuck in Pending/ContainerCreating), diagnostic steps (kubectl describe pod, check events, check resource limits), common causes (image pull failure, secret not found, insufficient resources), resolution steps

Add section '## Worker Crash Loop' with: symptoms (CrashLoopBackOff status), diagnostic steps (kubectl logs, check liveness probe, check CONFIG_DSN), common causes (invalid config DSN, missing secrets, OOM), resolution steps

Add section '## High Latency' with: symptoms (p99 > SLO), metrics to check (gateway_request_duration_seconds, worker_request_duration_seconds, gateway_cold_start_duration_seconds), diagnostic steps (check if cold starts, check connection latency, check CPU throttling), resolution steps

Add section '## Config Not Reloading' with: symptoms (worker_config_version stale, worker_reload_total{status=error} increasing), diagnostic steps (check version endpoint, check reload logs), common causes (network to gateway, parsing errors), resolution steps

Add section '## Circuit Breaker Open' with: symptoms (gateway_circuit_breaker_state == 1, 503 responses), diagnostic steps (check worker health, check error logs), recovery steps (wait for half-open probe, manual restart if needed), prevention (tune thresholds)

Add section '## Scale-to-Zero Issues' with: symptoms (requests failing during cold start, gateway_cold_start_duration_seconds > timeout), diagnostic steps (check KEDA ScaledObject, check Prometheus metrics), common causes (KEDA misconfiguration, slow image pull, slow startup), resolution steps (pre-warm, tune timeout, optimize startup)
Add section '## Useful Commands' with kubectl, curl, and prometheus query examples
Add section '## Alert Response' mapping each alert rule to its runbook section
acceptance_criteria: docs/runbook-dynamic-workers.md exists and is well-formatted markdown
Runbook covers all six required troubleshooting scenarios
Each section includes symptoms, diagnostic steps, and resolution steps
Commands and queries are specific to the actual metric names used in the codebase
